analogy.rationale: Somatostatin receptors (SSTR1-5) are Gi-coupled GPCRs that are poorly expressed in most of these cell lines, so somatostatin receptor agonists should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other GPCR ligands, especially opioid receptor agonists (which share OPRM1/OPRD1 off-target activity) and other neuropeptide/GPCR-targeting classes, though these too are expected to be weak in these cells.
